name: Vinegar has Plans
Text: Place an opponent's ally at the bottom of their Life Deck. If "Earth Dragon Ball 4" is in play you may place 2 allies instead of 1.

name: Vinegar's Revenge
Text: Choose one opponent. That opponent cannot gain their power stages until the beginning of your next turn. Remove from the game after use.

name: Vinegar, the Attacker
Text: Constant Combat Power: After every successful energy attack you perform, put the bottom card from your discard pile on the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Vinegar, the Battler HT
Text: Constant Combat Power: Do +1 power stage of damage with every successful energy attack.

name: Vinegar, the Fighter
Text: Constant Combat Power: When receiving damage from a successful energy attack, gain 2 power stages.

name: Vinegar, the Henchman
Text: Constant Combat Power: Gain 1 power stage after every successful physical attack you perform.

name: What Was I Thinking
Text: When entering Combat as the defender, search your Life Deck for an ally and put it into play at its highest power stage. This ally takes control of this Combat.

name: Where There's Life There's Hope
Text: Use this card just as an opponent wins by any means. The victory is postponed until the start of his next turn. Check for the victory conditions at that time. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.
